goal: Measure the finished quality of six never-audited subjects and fix what is small and safe
notes: Mode census (quality_audit.py mode), seed 2026-11-17-5df2. Subjects: research/energy-thermal-cost, ventures/uk-dividend-tax-calculator, research/capture-storage, ventures/kombucha-brewery-profit-calculator, research/sag-twin, ventures/landscape-lighting-bid-calculator. Share meeting the bar: 1 of 6 (uk-dividend-tax-calculator; census, not in the sampled share, which stays 33 of 306, Wilson 8% to 15%). All 6 finished. Seeded mutations caught 16 of 34. High defects: 4 (sag-twin and landscape-lighting fixed in PR #17026; energy-thermal-cost and capture-storage recorded as known gaps). Spot-checks by the orchestrator: UK taper next-1,000 = 537.50 by hand; sag-twin cold ratio 0.5712 = endurance(0.4)/twin(0.4) rerun; energy-thermal-cost full rerun with the charge billed from the cut-off reproduced 0.9/3.5/13.3 house and 1.3 district daily. Fix PR: https://github.com/Duncan-Haywood/oss-monorepo/pull/17026 (5 defects marked fixed_by). Local CI: run_workflow_locally --for-changes 14/15 passed; the one failure (generated research index) fixed and re-checked with research_live_links.py; agent-cross-review and portfolio-pages deploy jobs not runnable locally.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: six first audits at ~2 h each (recomputations, mutations) plus four small fixes with tests and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
